title: The Imitation Game: When LLMs Learn to Reason Like Programs via Code-Centric Reasoning Data Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2609.16076v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at programming tasks but frequently fail at deterministic, fine-grained reasoning in natural language, relying heavily on semantic approximations rather than robust symbolic execution. To bridge this gap, we propose MIMIC, a framework that leverages executable code as a rigorous medium for reasoning data synthesis. MIMIC fundamentally transforms algorithms into verifiable reasoning trajectories through narrative fusion, code-guided test synthesis, and dynamic code instrumentation. Crucially, these explicit intermediate execution states naturally form a Code-Instrumented Reward (CIR), providing dense, high-fidelity process supervision for reinforcement learning without external reward models. Extensive evaluations reveal that models trained via SFT and GRPO on our synthesized dataset achieve substantial, consistent gains. Our method significantly elevates accuracy across general reasoning, complex math

translated_title: 模仿游戏：当大语言模型通过以代码为中心的推理数据合成学会像程序一样推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在编程任务中表现出色，但在自然语言的确定性、细粒度推理方面经常失败，严重依赖语义近似而非稳健的符号执行。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了MIMIC，一个利用可执行代码作为严格媒介进行推理数据合成的框架。MIMIC通过叙事融合、代码引导的测试合成和动态代码插桩，从根本上将算法转化为可验证的推理轨迹。至关重要的是，这些显式的中间执行状态自然形成了代码插桩奖励（CIR），无需外部奖励模型即可为强化学习提供密集、高保真的过程监督。大量评估表明，在我们合成的数据集上通过SFT和GRPO训练的模型取得了显著且一致的提升。我们的方法在一般推理、复杂数学等任务上显著提升了准确率。
tldr: 提出MIMIC框架，以可执行代码为严格媒介合成可验证的推理轨迹数据，并利用代码插桩奖励（CIR）为强化学习提供无需外部奖励模型的密集高保真过程监督，从而显著提升大语言模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes MIMIC, a framework that leverages executable code as a rigorous medium for synthesizing verifiable reasoning trajectories, and uses Code-Instrumented Reward (CIR) to provide dense, high-fidelity process supervision for reinforcement learning without external reward models, substantially enhancing LLM reasoning capabilities.
